paragraphs: GreenCourt Legal Technologies sells software-as-a-service products that it says start saving time. Its GovLink product is aimed at agencies such as child support, insurance and public utilities. Its PeachCourt product handles electronic filing and is described as practically a direct line to the clerk's office.

GovLink combines system integrations, document management, workflow and notifications. The stated payoff is that customers spend more time on their core mission. PeachCourt captures filing information, documents and payments in one pass. It is built to integrate with any case management system. Courts using it are told they will not deal with merchant accounts, bad checks or chargebacks. Family, criminal and appeals cases are among those that can move from paper to online.

GreenCourt Legal Technologies, LLC was founded in 2014. Ownership sits with a small number of individuals. Those same people manage the company day to day, and it calls itself financially stable. Headquarters is in Carrollton, Georgia. Teammates also live in California, New Jersey and many places in between.
